create_dataloader: create a data loader by calling CreateDataLoader with an opt config object
create_dataloader_for_fashion: create a data loader for fashion datasets using CreateDataLoader with opt.name set to fashion
create_dataloader_for_demo: create a data loader for demo datasets using CreateDataLoader with opt.name set to demo
load_data_from_dataloader: load data by calling the load_data method on a CustomDatasetDataLoader instance
get_dataloader_length: get the dataset length by calling len on a CustomDatasetDataLoader instance
